description: Stable sort; detached shallow result. Ascending: nulls last; descending: nulls first. Finite numeric values use exact comparison; other values use natural comparable ordering. Unsupported mixed/object values fail. Cap 0..65536. sort_order accepts exactly ascending or descending.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to sort. The result is a detached shallow copy; values are not deep-copied. Inputs over 65536 items fail before output.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.description: Order accepts exactly ascending or descending; ascending places null values last and descending places null values first.

outputs.name: sorted_list
outputs.description: Stable sorted detached shallow copy. Finite numeric values use exact comparison and other homogeneous values use natural comparable ordering; results over 65536 items fail before output.

description: Stable descending sort; detached shallow result. Descending: nulls first. Finite numeric values use exact comparison; other values use natural comparable ordering. Unsupported mixed/object values fail. Cap 0..65536.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to sort descending. The result is a detached shallow copy; values are not deep-copied. Inputs over 65536 items fail before output.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Stable descending sorted detached shallow copy with null values first. Finite numeric values use exact comparison and other values use natural comparable ordering; results over 65536 items fail before output.

description: Stable-sort a shallow copy of a list by a property in ascending order. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, the property is required, null property values sort last, and unsupported property values fail.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to sort. The result is a detached shallow copy; missing or null input uses an empty list, and inputs over 65536 items fail before output.

inputs.name: property
inputs.description: Property used for comparison. A non-blank property is required.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: Returns a stable ascending shallow copy sorted by the selected property, with null property values last.
